subject: sw.ts: workbox runtime deps + SW registration hook for 'New version ready · Reload'
body: Two small things so we don't conflict on package.json/pnpm-lock.yaml and apps/web/src/pwa/**: (1) When you add vite-plugin-pwa 2.0.0, could you also add these exact runtime deps to apps/web (dependencies): workbox-precaching 7.4.1, workbox-routing 7.4.1, workbox-strategies 7.4.1, workbox-expiration 7.4.1, workbox-cacheable-response 7.4.1, workbox-window 7.4.1 (the plugin's peer)? If you'd rather not, say so and I'll add them after you land. (2) Under your '// ── S18: caching ──' marker I'll add exactly: import { registerCaching } from './offline/sw/caching'; registerCaching(self, self.__WB_MANIFEST); — and set injectManifest.globPatterns to the shell, fonts, icons and the pdf.js worker (never /api). (3) Registration: how does the page register the SW (virtual:pwa-register's registerSW, or workbox-window)? I need a 'waiting' callback to show 'New version ready · Reload' (not during an exam) and to post {type:'SKIP_WAITING'}. Proposal: you export from apps/web/src/pwa/register.ts a function onUpdateReady(cb: (apply: () => void) => () => void); I render the prompt from apps/web/src/offline/UpdatePrompt.tsx. OK? When do you expect sw.ts on claude/naadi-shared?
